notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[olist]
[ * ] Fixed displaying one ending in the reference book.
[ * ] Added support for 1280*1024 resolution. 
[ * ] Small text edits.
[/olist]
We would like to thank the players who reported any bugs to us!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
In the days that have passed since the release of Scribe, we have collected information about the identified errors and promptly fixed them. In addition, we have added new content that was planned at the development stage.
[olist]
[*] New content added. Now you can open 2 more endings in the directory. Good luck!  
[ * ] Added support for 1680*1050 resolution. 
[ * ] Fixed the display of some recipients. 
[ * ] Fixed an issue where days could be skipped. 
[ * ] Fixed text disappearing when writing some emails.
[/olist]
We would like to thank the players who reported any bugs to us!
